about: Crops of a real game capture, the background of review-on-game.mjs. Captured by Core's road variant tool on 2026-10-11 from origin/develop in headless Chrome: seed 4242, spring, noon, clear, 1440x900 at DPR 1, the files track-z1.png and track-z2.png (ground, nature and track). The crop box is in screenshot pixels; a tile (tx, ty) has its centre at tile00Centre + tx * stepTx + ty * stepTy on the flat area's level (x 84-91, y 72-77). The regular track runs along tile x on row 75, the narrow track along tile y on column 88, and they cross at (88, 75).
